description: Shared test vectors for the Agent Bureau's subject dispute records (docs/disputes.md), which CounterAudit seals through the agent-bureau-dispute-v1 connector. valid records pass the form check and carry real signatures: a subject's over EIP-191 personal_sign of signing_payload as raw bytes, by the subject key's address; a furnisher's Ed25519 over the same payload, with the furnisher key. Each invalid record breaks the one rule named. Built by scripts/dispute-vectors.ts in the-agent-bureau. The keys are test keys from fixed seeds.
